resonator_configuration.multifunction_strategy: Replaceable keyed sockets and A/B drive buses allow alternating, paired, swept and redundant configurations without asserting material-specific performance.

mandatory_inspections: dimensional inspection before and after sanding
plating thickness map from witness coupons
outgassing and flammability screening for intended environment
NDE or proof testing of structural load paths
process_research_findings: Polymer-to-metal adhesion depends strongly on substrate chemistry, surface topography, activation and seed-layer process.
A plating process proven on one polymer, print process or geometry cannot be transferred without representative coupons and environmental testing.
Sanding is a dimensional operation and must be controlled against datum surfaces and recorded before and after finishing.
Conductive continuity does not establish structural adhesion, vacuum compatibility, corrosion resistance or fatigue life.

source_conflicts.description: The v0.1 workbook encoded six solenoid positions, while the original Mark III schematic states three solenoids per segment.
source_conflicts.resolution: v0.3 models six body sectors with three compact axial solenoid cartridges each (18 total). Performance and electrical values remain unassigned.

source_conflicts.description: The v0.1 workbook encoded four resonators, while the original schematic defines central, surrounding, peripheral and supporting Flower-of-Life roles.
source_conflicts.resolution: v0.3 provides 25 replaceable sockets: one central, six surrounding, twelve peripheral and six support sockets, placed as two interleaved spirals with Flower-of-Life role bands.

source_conflicts.description: Original source claims for xenon damping/amplification, doped crystals, graphene-filled solenoids and extraction performance are not supported by measured qualification evidence.
source_conflicts.resolution: Retain only replaceable envelopes, role labels and test interfaces. Treat media, doping, fill, field and extraction claims as quarantined hypotheses.

source_conflicts.description: Electroplating is requested as part of the build path, but substrate, surface preparation, seed layer, metal stack, thickness, internal stress and environmental compatibility are not qualified.
source_conflicts.resolution: Include configurable plating allowance, drainage, masking lands, electrical contact tabs and witness coupons. Release only after coupon-led process qualification by a competent plater and engineering review.

known_unknowns.description: Qualified print substrate, infill, raster, wall schedule, moisture control and batch traceability are unknown.
Sanding, sealing, activation, seed and electroplate stack require coupon-led adhesion, thickness, stress and thermal-cycle qualification.
Fastener inserts, captive hardware, thread engagement, conductive bonding and galvanic isolation are unselected.
Coupler structural loads, sealing, alignment tolerance and repeated-cycle life are unknown.
Solenoid conductor, turn count, insulation, current, thermal rejection, switching and field map are unverified.
Resonator material, doping, frequency, Q, acceleration, coupling and assay response require calibrated blank-controlled tests.
Battery, BMS and capacitor architecture requires measured capacity, ESR/DCIR, pulse, containment and thermal evidence.
Cable gauges, connectors, shielding, grounding, bonding, isolation and bend radii require electrical design and EMC testing.
Arm and mast joint loads, actuator/tendon selection, torque, reach, stiffness, collision and latch life are unknown.
Damping chamber medium, pressure, containment, venting and claimed EMI/energy effects remain specialist-review placeholders.
Thermal paths and radiative rejection for coils, energy storage, electronics and plated polymer are unverified.
Vacuum outgassing, flammability, atomic oxygen, radiation and contamination compatibility of all polymers, sealants and coatings are unknown.
Array-level bus sharing, synchronization, thermal interaction, field interaction and coupler loads are unknown.
Manufacturing tolerances, inspection methods, assembly sequence, repair limits and acceptance sampling are not established.
No deployment release exists; environmental and structural qualification articles must precede any mission article.

Propulsion/attitude-control architecture, working fluid or propellant, reservoir construction, pressure, valves, plumbing, nozzle geometry, thrust, impulse, thermal rejection, contamination control and refill interface are unselected and unqualified.

claim_gates: No validated extraction, separation, efficiency, field-strength, current, resonance or material-response claim.
No high-current, pressure, vacuum, gas-handling, electrochemical or energy-safety approval.
No flight, human-rating, payload-handling, arm-load, capture, deployment or collision-avoidance certification.
Print and plating artifacts are manufacturing references, not released structural or electrical hardware.
No radioactive material, xenon pressure, crystal doping or graphene-fill implementation is authorised by this package.
No manufacturing release, public capability promotion or operational deployment approval.
Synthetic corpus confidence labels do not override missing empirical test evidence.
No propellant, pressure-vessel, thruster, nozzle, thrust, impulse or operational propulsion approval is authorised; propulsion geometry is interface/allocation-only.
